title: Official I-009 overwrite-crop (param=gainDb) and effectIds.* lock coverage
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of path-sorted sha256sum output in "digest  path\n" form (sort by path)
bounds: This slice adds official coverage only for two recorded Increment 2.02 gaps. It does not open new audio capabilities.

Official overwrite paste of an admitted type=gain clip Effect crops the destination remnant and rebinds the incoming copy; every keyframe keeps param=gainDb; cropped boundary values match the existing cropGainPoints contract. Production overwrite.dart is unchanged.

lockedFields values that start with effectIds. (effectIds.<effectId> and effectIds.gain) refuse user SetClipGain / SetGainKeyframe / RemoveGainKeyframe with FIELD_LOCKED, refuse applyOfficialClipAnalysis with MANUAL_LOCKED, and refuse an overwrite paste that would crop the locked clip with FIELD_LOCKED. The document is unchanged. Production startsWith("effectIds.") is unchanged.

The frozen Increment 2.02 test file i009_clip_gain_effect_test.dart is not rewritten. Independent audio import, bus Effect/limiter, I-060/V-024, I-007 remapping/nest, new-track, InversePatch (stays restoreSnapshot), Pulse/clock/queue, invert-matrix rows, caption export, and cross-device/RTC are not opened. Store tests and the Increment 1.88 SDK 1000-sequence undo suite were not run. I-009 stays partial. Increment 1.17/1.18 stay open. I-023 stays partial.
